scope: Official-source recovery audit for Surrey County Council by-elections previously lacking candidate-result evidence. This file records retrieval status only; it does not supply missing candidate values.

records.source_type: Surrey County Council meeting minutes and indexed official result announcement
records.evidence_text: The official Council minutes confirm Ramon Gray was elected for Weybridge following the 7 May 2015 by-election. An indexed Surrey County Council news announcement additionally reports Ramon Gray received 4,190 votes and Peter Harman was the nearest rival, 2,291 votes behind; the reviewed accessible evidence does not provide a complete candidate table.
records.notes: The original official Surrey News announcement is now redirected: https://news.surreycc.gov.uk/2015/05/08/ramon-gray-wins-county-council-by-election/. Partial winner and runner-up information is not treated as a complete candidate-level result. No candidate rows were created.

records.source_type: Epsom & Ewell Borough Council declaration of result
records.evidence_text: The official declaration publishes all six candidates, party descriptions, votes, the elected candidate, one vacant seat, electorate, ballot papers issued, rejected ballots and turnout. It does not publish candidate vote shares or total votes.
records.notes: Vote shares and total votes were not calculated from the declaration; their fields remain null.

records.source_type: Waverley Borough Council official County election result page
records.evidence_text: The official Waverley Borough Council result page publishes five candidates, party descriptions, votes, vote shares, outcomes, one seat, total votes, electorate, ballot papers issued, rejected ballots and turnout for the Surrey County Council Farnham South by-election on 18 August 2016.
records.notes: The recovered official result page is integrated as a Waverley-published Surrey County Council election source; it does not replace any Surrey archive value.

records.source_type: Waverley Borough Council official County election result page
records.evidence_text: The official Waverley Borough Council result page publishes four candidates, party descriptions, votes, vote shares, outcomes, one seat, total votes, electorate, ballot papers issued, rejected ballots and turnout for the Surrey County Council Haslemere by-election on 7 July 2026.
records.notes: The recovered official result page is integrated as a Waverley-published Surrey County Council election source; it does not replace any Surrey archive value.
